# Notices and upstream provenance

This corpus is an index and adaptation layer over many independent sources.
Every `.lsys` record and every `catalog.json` entry identifies its source URL,
revision or locator when available, and the license information that was found.

Some historical rule catalogs do not state reuse terms.  Their concise grammar
specifications are retained for research provenance and interoperability; no
license is inferred.  Repository-level licenses also may not resolve the
authorship of older rules imported by that repository.  Review the relevant
record before redistribution or commercial use.

Important licensed source ecosystems represented here include BSD-3-Clause
(resetius/lsystem and Elm L-System Studio), MIT (ofxLSystem and
Notgnoshi/generative), CeCILL/GPL-compatible or GPL-3 (OpenAlea L-Py and
GroIMP), and CC BY-NC-SA 3.0 (the NetLogo L-System Fractals model). Sources
with no standalone or explicit license located include the Fractint rule
files, Paul Bourke's catalog, the Wolfram Function Repository `LSystem`
resource page, jkubin/L-system, Kit Wallace's OpenSCAD catalog,
propfeds/L-systems-renderer, L3D, and gerizim16/3d-l-system-generator.

The source guide provides the exact audit notes.  This notice does not replace
any upstream license or attribution requirement.
